title: The day after, the tarp
logline: The lawn chair under its tarp again, the string lights on in daylight because nobody turned them off, one bulb out. The page after the one chair.

panels.composition: An old lawn chair on a dock under a tied tarp, string lights along a shingle shack's eave lit in gray daylight with one bulb dark.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, an old lawn chair on a wooden dock under a tied tarp with colored string lights along a shingle shack's eave lit in gray daylight and one bulb dark, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
